Class HelpScreen

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.ui.tui.screen.HelpScreen
public class HelpScreen extends Object
TUI screen that displays the list of all available commands and their descriptions. Each command is shown with its syntax in yellow followed by a description in white. The screen blocks until the player presses Backspace to return to the previous view.

    • NAME_COLUMN_WIDTH

      private static final int NAME_COLUMN_WIDTH
      Width, in characters, reserved for the command-name column so that all description columns line up regardless of individual name length. Derived from the longest entry in EXPLANATIONS plus a small margin, so adding a longer command name later does not require a manual adjustment here.

    • display

      public void display() throws IOException
      Renders the help screen and blocks until the player presses Backspace. Saves and restores the terminal state and attributes around the display.
      Throws:
      IOException - if a terminal I/O error occurs

    • saveTerminalState

      private void saveTerminalState()
      Saves the terminal state by hiding the cursor.

    • restoreTerminalState

      private void restoreTerminalState()
      Restores the terminal state by making the cursor visible and resetting ANSI styles.

    • renderHelpScreen

      public void renderHelpScreen()
      Renders the help screen content into the internal buffers and flushes it to the terminal.

      Must be public: ViewTUI stores a reference to this method (helpScreen::renderHelpScreen) in its activeOverlayRenderer field so the help screen can be re-rendered in place on a terminal resize while it is being displayed.

    • printAt

      private void printAt(int row, int col, String text, org.jline.utils.AttributedStyle style)
      Writes the given text into the screen and color buffers at the specified position, clipping any characters that fall outside the terminal width.
      Parameters:
      row - the zero-based row index to write at
      col - the zero-based column index to start writing from
      text - the text to write
      style - the ANSI style to apply to the written characters

    • printAt

      private void printAt(int row, int col, String text, int maxWidth, org.jline.utils.AttributedStyle style)
      Writes the given text into the screen and color buffers at the specified position, truncating it with an ellipsis if it exceeds maxWidth characters.
      Parameters:
      row - the zero-based row index to write at
      col - the zero-based column index to start writing from
      text - the text to write; ignored if null or empty
      maxWidth - the maximum number of characters to write before truncating
      style - the ANSI style to apply to the written characters

    • flushBuffers

      private void flushBuffers()
      Flushes the screen and color buffers to the terminal. Clears any remaining content below the rendered area.

    • waitForBackspace

      private void waitForBackspace()
      Blocks the current thread until the player presses Backspace (ASCII 8). Any other key press is ignored.
